intro: Old Brine, at your service. I am the spirit in the figurehead. You bring the life; I will keep the tale.
Welcome aboard. I am Old Brine. Every fine voyage begins with somebody getting out the door.
Aye, I am the wooden fellow at the bow. Old Brine. Go live a little, then come tell me what we are sailing on.
activity_logged: {actor} logged {activity}. Into the log: {supplies} Supplies, {moves} Island Moves, and {legend} Legend. Real life keeps us sailing.
Aye, {actor}: {activity}, logged. That adds {supplies} Supplies, {moves} Island Moves, and {legend} Legend. A useful page in our tale.
Put it in ink: {actor} logged {activity}, earning {supplies} Supplies, {moves} Island Moves, and {legend} Legend. Well lived, well logged.
move: {actor} steps onto {terrain}. {movesRemaining} Island Moves remain. Every good map starts under somebody's boots.
Boots down, {actor}: {terrain}. {movesRemaining} Island Moves left. I shall admire the view from my wooden nose.
{terrain} beneath your boots, {actor}. {movesRemaining} Island Moves remain. A fine place for the next sentence.
item_found: {actor} found {item}. A discovery worth a line in the log!
Well spotted, {actor}: {item}. That deserves a satisfying underline.
{item}, found by {actor}. My wooden eyes would have sailed straight past it.
chaos: {disaster} at {island}! Steady, crew. I am putting an enormous exclamation mark in the log.
News from {island}: {disaster}. A dramatic turn of the page, that.
{island} reports {disaster}. Hold your hats, crew; the tale has found its loud bit.
boss_victory: {actor} defeated {boss} on {island}! A victory worth telling with your whole chest.
Ring it out: {actor} defeated {boss} on {island}. I would applaud, but the shipwright forgot my hands.
{boss} on {island}, defeated by {actor}! There is a sentence I shall enjoy reading again.
streak_milestone: {actor} has reached {days} Calm Seas days. Quiet choices can make a mighty fine story.
{days} Calm Seas days for {actor}. That is some patient seamanship, mate.
Mark it proudly: {actor}, {days} Calm Seas days. A little space for life, day by day.
streak_reset: {actor}, the streak begins afresh. Your earned progress stays yours. Take the next day as it comes.
A fresh start for {actor}'s streak. Nothing earned is lost. There is room in this tale for an ordinary day.
{actor}'s streak has reset; earned progress remains. No scolding from an old piece of driftwood. Onward when you are ready.
crew_joined: {actor} has joined {crew}. Welcome aboard; there is room for another voice in this tale.
A new name in the log: {actor}, now with {crew}. Good to have you aboard.
{crew}, meet {actor}, your newest crewmate. I shall try to remember the name before the next introduction.
island_arrival: {crew} has arrived at {island}. A new shore, a fresh page. Take a good look around.
Arrival logged: {crew}, at {island}. Every shore deserves a proper introduction.
There it is: {island}. {crew} has arrived. I do enjoy this part of the tale.
recap_empty: No new entries since your last visit. A quiet page is still part of the voyage.
The log has nothing new to report. Take your time, mate; a good tale has breathing room.
All caught up. No new entries in the log. Go enjoy a little life; I will mind the bookmark.
